title: should create a team and show it on the teams list
verifies: a uniquely-named team is created via the drawer and its row appears on the Teams list

title: should open a team and render its five tabs
verifies: clicking a team opens the detail view with the title and all five tabs (overview/schedule/members/policy/ownership) rendered

title: should add a member to a team
verifies: picking an org user in the Members tab persists the member and shows their email in the roster

title: should edit a team name and description
verifies: renaming a team via the edit drawer updates the detail title

title: should delete a team after confirmation
verifies: deleting a team with the confirm dialog removes its row from the list

title: should filter the teams list by search
verifies: the search box filters the list so only matching teams remain
